I played through Chrono Trigger and loved it, I get that, but by the time I had finished Chrono Cross for the first time I liked it much better, complex battle system and all. It remains my favorite console game, ever. I have my original save file saved to an emulated memory card on my pc and have replayed the game 6 times on the original file, and one of the reasons its such a great game is that there have been differences in subsequent run throughs, not just in party makeup etc, but actual changes to scripted events.

Yes it's different. No it's not a cookie cutter replica of Chrono Trigger with a handful of new abilities and characters, and I feel sad for those who wish it was and don't understand why that would be a bad thing. If they kept crapping out the same thing it would just be the Call of Duty of JRPGs.
